Name: Social Page Order Menu
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
To use this mod, open the game menu and switch to the social tab. You should see a drop-down menu below the list of relations. Holding down the left mouse button over the drop-down menu lets you sort your relations in four ways:

[list=1]
[*]Sort by hearts (ascending)
[*]Sort by hearts (descending)
[*]Sort by display name (ascending)
[*]Sort by display name (descending)
[/list]
Simple!

There are also customizable keys you can use to cycle through the sort options (default [b]Up Arrow[/b] and [b]Down Arrow[/b]).


[youtube]atcUvSio6E0[/youtube]


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
